substack-220525637-c009 · analytical principle

If agents move idle deposits to higher-yield instruments and banks must retain funding at higher rates, bank and brokerage net interest margins fall.

Right
Source · 8:13-9:55 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceconditional
Horizonnot stated
Materialitymajor

The conditional relationship follows from the explicit assumptions; it does not establish that those assumptions hold in observed markets.

Conditional reasoning

Net interest income equals interest on assets minus interest on funding. Raising the funding rate on a positive balance reduces net interest income and margin, all else equal.

  • Asset yields, loan balances and other funding costs are held fixed.
  • Departing low-cost deposits are replaced with higher-cost funding or repriced to retain them.

substack-220525637-c022 · analytical principle

Higher sustainable returns on tangible equity justify higher price-to-tangible-book valuations when risk, growth and accounting are otherwise comparable.

Right
Source · 19:57-21:09 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceasserted
Horizonnot stated
Materialitymajor

The conditional relationship follows from the explicit assumptions; it does not establish that those assumptions hold in observed markets.

Conditional reasoning

Residual-income valuation gives P/B=(ROTCE-g)/(r-g). Holding r and g fixed, a higher sustainable ROTCE increases the justified P/B. This does not independently verify the episode's quoted market multiples.

  • Clean-surplus equity accounting, perpetual stable growth g below required return r.
  • Sustainable ROTCE and payout are consistent with retained-equity growth.
  • Comparable risk, growth and tangible-equity definitions.

Assessment test: Inspect the relevant original financial, operational or economic data and compare the claimed mechanism with competing explanations.

Further verification: Recheck the original data and subsequent realized outcomes.

How he reasons here

  • Separate current loan quality from forward stock valuation.
  • Decompose bank revenue and distinguish GAAP from settlement-adjusted returns.
  • Use sustainable ROTCE relative to required returns to interpret tangible-book multiples.
  • Monitor funding dependence and agent-driven erosion of customer inertia.
  • Explicitly revises the banks-as-economy-leading-indicator rule.
